description: This file implements the Windows-specific MIDI manager for the Chromium media component, handling MIDI device enumeration, input/output port management, and MIDI message processing with system callbacks.

classes.name: midi::MidiManagerWin::PortManager
classes.description: Manages MIDI port handles, device enumeration, and callback handling for MIDI input/output ports.

classes.name: midi::Port
classes.description: Base class representing a MIDI port with common properties and connection management.

classes.name: midi::MidiManagerWin::InPort
classes.description: Represents a MIDI input port, handles device opening, buffer management, and callback processing.

classes.name: midi::MidiManagerWin::OutPort
classes.description: Represents a MIDI output port, handles sending MIDI messages and device connection.

methods.name: CalculateInEventTime
methods.description: Calculates the event time from elapsed milliseconds for input ports.

methods.name: RegisterInHandle
methods.description: Registers an HMIDIIN handle with its port index.

methods.name: FindInHandle
methods.description: Finds the port index associated with an HMIDIIN handle.

methods.name: RestoreInBuffer
methods.description: Restores the input buffer for the specified port index.

methods.name: HandleMidiInCallback
methods.description: Static callback handling MIDI input messages.

methods.name: HandleMidiOutCallback
methods.description: Static callback handling MIDI output messages.
